notes: PRESENT MODE: the Present button in the top bar (or F11; Cmd Shift F on a Mac) shows a screen to a meeting: full screen, large text, the menu tucked away; Menu calls it back, Esc leaves. Sharing an old bill between revenue centres now keeps what its lines say, and putting a shared bill under one centre moves every line. Take a backup first: Setup, Backup, Back up now. No upgrade of the books: backups move freely between 1.7.0 and 1.8.3. Update the main computer first.
